edits.old: - The release date 30 November 2026 is tentative and is copied unchanged.
edits.new:
- The release date 30 November 2026 is tentative and is copied unchanged.
- Volume: no deviation, screening or queue volume is stated for this module in the source documents (GAP-1833). The platform figures are NFR-001 (23,600 open cases at go-live, 3,110 new a month), NFR-002 (about 370 staff online of 914) and NFR-011 (300 milliseconds per rule evaluation); the evaluation samples are 200 and 500 cases. The deviation rate is measured in the shadow run before the wave 2 volume test is sized.

edits.old: - The service identity SY-AGENT holds the case, document and ledger reads of section 12.2, so each read is answered under the same role check as a person; the refusals of MSG-P4-002 are proved through the platform guard.
edits.new: - The service identity SY-AGENT holds the case, document and ledger reads of section 12.2, so each read is answered under the same role check as a person; the refusals of MSG-P4-002 are proved through the platform guard. SY-AGENT holds Documents R with every personal field masked, and no clear value appears in the answer, the log or the trace; the mask format and the per-role field list are in the rwb-access masking contract (GAP-1049).

edits.old: - The rwb-document contract is published: `GET /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/documents` and `GET /api/recovery/document/v1/documents/{documentId}` with the stored `document_field` values.
edits.new:
- The rwb-document contract is published: `GET /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/documents` and `GET /api/recovery/document/v1/documents/{documentId}` with the stored `document_field` values.
- A stored document is served with the type on its row and is never re-typed on read; the unknown-type refusal of 422 and MSG-P5-006 applies at store time only (GAP-1050).

disposition.target: Ownership Map and TSD S8 T-A.1 of the S8 context pack
disposition.change: Publish the deviation read as a service operation with a catalogue row; publish the agent-policy read operation name and fields; bind the shadow refusal to one status; publish codes and owner roles of R-DEV-05 and R-DEV-06 with package version; set the answer limit and the test level of the ten legacy cases.
disposition.note: Story section 3 already names the rwb-deviation read; the Ownership Map and the S8 rule-set and parameter sources must carry the missing values.

disposition.target: RWB-P10-E1062-CON and TSD P10 v2 T-A.1
disposition.change: Add the run-start operation on /api/recovery/agent/v1 with its request members and refusal codes; name the case, parameter, deviation, ledger and document read paths with a 2 s budget each; publish the run and proposal events on rwb.agent.events.v1; publish the screening feature flag and the failed tool-call status.
disposition.note: Story keeps the GAP-0614 login line open; the run-start and read paths are fixed in the contract, not in this story.

disposition.change: Align the test lists of REQ-DVH-001, REQ-DVH-003 and REQ-DVH-007 with section 18 of RWB-P10-E1062-APP.
disposition.note: Section 18 kept as written; RTM v7 traces different tests for three requirements and is aligned in its next version.
Line 192 is not in this chunk and the service's next Flyway number is not given in the sources, so no number can be set without inventing one.
The inherited history table is not in this chunk and the v1 and v2 change notes are not in the sources, so the not-specified rows cannot be placed.
Section 3 now states the platform figures and the two samples, asserts no module volume and sets the shadow measurement before wave 2 sizing.

disposition.target: RWB-P10-E1062-CON and the rwb-document AsyncAPI and OpenAPI documents

disposition.note: The mapping belongs in the contract and the rwb-document specifications, not in this story's text.

disposition.target: AsyncAPI document of rwb.document.events.v1 and RWB-P10-E1062-CON
